title: An Outstanding App... but nothing’s perfect
body:
This app is incredible, to such an extent that I even made an in-app purchase, something which I very rarely do, after just 1 day of use as I knew this was exactly the UX that I envisaged. However, nothing’s perfect and I would like to see:

1. Better Organisation - though I can just about make do with colours as of now, perhaps adding “groups” of sorts would be better, and then assign each group its own colour. For instance, I have organised all of my “Sports” activities into the green colour and all of my “chores” activities into the blue, etc.

2. More Controls - The daily reminder feature that you have set as of now is only a first step into what I would like. As a pro user, if you could somehow intergrate multiple “ticks” per day, for instance, I might need to take an antibiotic four times a day (and be able to set the time for each respective reminder), that would be absolutely incredible. Conversely, on the other side of the spectrum, for some events that I need to do every several days or several months, setting a reminder at intervals for several months or years would be similarly great!

Keep up the good work! And by the way, a final lowest-priority suggestion would be if you could manage to make your app cross-platform through a web app, such as the way Todoist operates, so I can tick things, but honestly, I can usually just whip out my phone to do so.

title: Good simple habit tracker
body: This is what I was looking for, very clean and simple and most importantly totally free. There are a couple of features missing which would really make it perfect. Firstly the ability to change the colour of each task manually, it seems it is chosen at randomly at the moment. Also I would like the option to view the task cards in a more compact way so I could see more on the screen at a time. Thanks!

author: zoecn

title: Well-designed for a free app
body:
Great app which has most of the features that the paid habit tracking apps do. Clean interface and the daily ticks encourage you to maintain the habit. Helping me to keep track of my habits 🙂

Maybe it is a little bit fickle of me, but would be great to have haptic and sound feedback when marking a habit as done or achieving a goal. Adds to the appification of habit-building through small audial reinforcement.
